column1: # Reviewed semantic identities for GAME camera-path interpolation and map-event state.
# Every row was checked with kf sema addr/disasm --blocks/xref/xref --callees/strings, CFG JSON,
# Ghidra candidates, callers and adjacent boundaries, source/history/match state, and FID/vendor controls.
# The two families share an investigation band only; adjacency is not translation-unit evidence.

column6: multi-block segment setup; advances a 0x1c-byte point index, recognizes x=-1 termination, derives distance with SquareRoot0, divides distance times eight by speed, and prepares Q4 position plus wrapped rotation deltas
column7: called only by camera_path_begin and camera_path_step; three direct calls to angle_shortest_delta; no strings; the loaded point table at 0x800561d0 remains unnamed because its apparent extent and termination are not yet proven
column8: a0 is consistently the complete 0x64-byte state; field widths follow lw, lh, lhu, sw, and sh access and both callers
column9: absent from vendored inventories and no Psy-Q FID; behavior is game camera interpolation
column12: supported; semantics and layout are coherent, while point-table ownership remains open
